name: emitted-size-limits
goal: A verification freezes and enforces the size of what each unit emits, separately for every execution target, beside its source limits: growth of one target without a reviewed approval fails, as does an output that was measured at its baseline and is gone, and an output that becomes measurable needs a reviewed limit

evidence: The first real record (b141c19f of 1d5f793) holds 3799 measurements and 1620 budget findings: source-bytes, complexity and dependencies for each of 539 units and three latency findings, but none for the two sizes the kernel emits, process 402048 bytes and Wasm 143132 bytes. An output could grow or vanish and nothing would fail. Expected: each execution target has a frozen size of its own in the ledger; growth without approval, an output gone since its baseline, and an output without a reviewed limit all fail; a module has none.

work/logs/stage-f-emitted-size-RED.log: bunx vitest run test/budget-artifacts.e2e.test.ts on the unchanged budget code, 4 failed: the first baseline held no emitted size; a process output grown from 3 to 7 bytes with the source size unchanged verified as passed with exit 0; an output no longer built verified with exit 0; an unbuilt output was not recorded as unmeasured.

New unit function.emitted-sizes (generated). unitMeasurements gives one emitted size per execution target, a sum within a target, no value when a part was not built. budgetFindings judges each against artifact-bytes:<target> whenever the unit is judged; BudgetService words the failures with the target; signBudget freezes and approves them; the record assembly also judges units reached through a dependency that emit an output; budget measure names the target; the finding schema gains an optional target. Only sizes measured from the snapshot's own build are frozen: the real record also holds sizes a benchmark reported, with a machine profile.

work/logs/stage-f-emitted-size-green-2.log: test/budget-artifacts.e2e.test.ts 5 passed through the public verifier in clean fixture snapshots with CLI baselines and approvals: 3 to 7 bytes on one target fails although the other shrank by as much and the source kept its size; approval stays in the ledger with before and after; a missing output fails; an unbuilt output is stated and needs approval once built; an output a unit starts to emit needs approval. test/utils/emitted-sizes.test.ts 5 passed. The existing budget, measurement, kernel and verify suites passed unchanged, 63 files and 170 tests (work/logs/stage-f-emitted-size-related.log).

bun run check exit 0 on the working tree (work/logs/stage-f-check-8.log): 458 unit tests with 25 live-API tests skipped, 183 command-line end-to-end tests in 56 files, 31 package tests in 12 files with 3 scale tests skipped, 121 reports unit tests in 55 files, audit and registry check passed. Whole browser suite on the final build: 120 passed, 1 skipped (work/logs/stage-f-browser-suite-three-gaps-final.log). The complete verification was not run; it is Codex's. No page changed for this loop: the unit panel does not show emitted limits yet, which is stated as open.
